channel.title: AI Changelog
channel.description: New AI and data science papers, repos, models, tools and news.

item.title: [news] Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
item.description: A conversation with Sam Nickless, Partner and Chief Executive Officer at Gilbert + Tobin.

item.title: [news] ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
item.description: More than 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus to prepare for civilian careers.

item.title: [news] BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
[news] Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Kimi K3.1 Pro from Moonshot AI is now available on Amazon Bedrock for building applications and using as a coding assistant in OpenCode.

item.title: [news] Build a daily dependency watcher with LangGraph and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore web search
item.description: The Web Search API in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gives agents current, cited web results signed with existing AWS credentials.

item.title: [news] The agent evaluation playbook: Built-in, DeepEval, and AutoEval on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations
item.description: When you deploy an agent, whether it is working is really several questions: did it finish the task, stay on topic, leak data, or skip steps?

item.title: [news] Tracking Anthropic-discovered vulnerabilities
item.description: Tool that tracks vulnerabilities discovered by Anthropic to monitor disclosed CVEs and fix rates.

item.title: [news] Apple has new Mac app coming to make running local AI models easy
item.description: Mac application that turns Apple silicon computers into a private local AI inference server.

item.title: [news] Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
item.description: Microsoft researchers discovered a backdoor technique called Lazarus that can reprogram dormant neurons in an AI model to execute malicious commands.

item.title: [news] llm-gemini 0.36
item.description: Release: llm-gemini 0.36 Gemini 4 Carbon was announced two weeks ago for "a subset of cyber defenders", but today it's available to everyone else .

item.title: [paper] Medical Image Segmentation: Foundation Model Adaptation versus Task-Specific Training
item.description: Researchers adapted the DINOv2 foundation model for medical image segmentation and found it generalized better on external datasets compared to task-specific models.

item.title: [paper] Toward Foundation Detection Models via Example-Based Grounding in EM-DETR
item.description: Researchers introduce a student-teacher training strategy and adapt the EM-DETR framework to build a multi-domain foundation model for medical lesion detection.

item.title: [paper] TorchCurves: Differentiable Parametric Curves
item.description: TorchCurves is a PyTorch library that treats vector-valued parametric curves as learnable primitives for applications like continuous feature embeddings and functional regression.

item.title: [paper] AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
item.description: AutoScaffold is an AI-for-AI framework that automatically generates and adapts training scaffolds from student experience, outperforming standard reinforcement learning baselines across four diverse domains.

item.title: [paper] Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
item.description: Contrastive Discovery replaces pointwise hypothesis testing with mutually exclusive competing explanations in LLM agents, resolving scientific questions more effectively and outperforming pointwise search.

item.title: [paper] Pyrite: Building and Benchmarking Protein-Ligand Pose Ranking Agents
item.description: Pyrite introduces a pairwise protein-ligand pose-ranking benchmark and LLM-based agents that use structured representations and feature discovery to exceed expert performance in small-molecule drug discovery.

item.title: [paper] When Does the Real Wiring Win? Testing connectome structure-function claims against unmeasured physiology
item.description: A comparative study of connectome-constrained models reveals that tuning methodology and physiological assumptions critically impact whether biological wiring diagrams outperform shuffled null models.

item.title: [paper] Continual-ARC: Measuring Skill Acquisition over a Working Lifetime
item.description: Continual-ARC is a lifelong evaluation stream built from ARC-AGI tasks that measures both memorization and generalization across memory-based and weight-based learning systems.

item.title: [paper] Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
item.description: Bonbon is a multimodal foundation model for molecular interactions that exhibits zero-shot emergent functional, residue, and bond capabilities from paired protein-ligand sequences.

item.title: [paper] Measuring Robustness and Efficiency in a Connectome-Constrained Fly Visual System Model: Linking an Adversarial and a Perceptual Illusion
item.description: FlyNet is a connectome-constrained neural network model of the fly visual system that achieves high computational efficiency and robust collision detection compared to standard artificial neural networks.

item.title: [paper] RS-JEPA: Remote Sensing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture with Scan-Path Views for Cross-Sensor Image Retrieval
item.description: RS-JEPA is a compact joint-embedding predictive architecture using Vision Mamba encoders and scan-path views to achieve effective cross-sensor remote sensing image retrieval.

item.title: [paper] Comparative Analysis of Agent Evaluation Frameworks: Stability, Detection, and Discovery in Enterprise Analytics Agents
item.description: A three-phase comparative study of enterprise analytics agent evaluation frameworks demonstrates that trace-based evaluation and adversarial red-teaming provide complementary detection of failures.

item.title: [paper] ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows
item.description: ReTrace distills natural language standard operating procedures and logged agent runs into efficient, reusable programmatic workflows that lower cost and latency while maintaining high task completion rates.

item.title: [paper] TimeSeek: Multi-Task and Multi-Domain Pretraining for Generalized Time Series Analytics
item.description: TimeSeek is a generalized time series model that combines multi-domain feature extraction and multi-task collaborative training to improve performance across diverse forecasting and anomaly detection tasks.

item.title: [paper] Re-Search: Dissecting LLM Ideation Through a Two-Player Questioning Game
item.description: Re-Search is an evaluation framework based on Twenty Questions that tracks how large language models explore research ideas, revealing that generation is the primary bottleneck in automated ideation.

item.title: [paper] Mechanistic Interpretability Needs a Logic of Inference
item.description: This paper establishes five principles and a recursive logic of inference to improve how mechanistic interpretability identifies and validates neural network computations.

item.title: [paper] Pterodactyl: Pushing the Limits of Efficient Automated Translation Evaluation
item.description: Pterodactyl is an ultra-low-cost automated translation evaluation system designed for binary classification tasks like segment-level quality scoring and error-free detection using an LLM-as-a-judge approach.

item.title: [paper] FERN: Cross-Benchmark Table Retrieval for Text-to-SQL with Frozen Retrievers and Learned Ranking
item.description: FERN is a table retrieval system for Text-to-SQL tasks that combines frozen retrievers with a LightGBM ranker to efficiently select relevant database tables without using generative large language models.

item.title: [paper] BoviShift: A Six-Year Multi-Attribute Audit of Visual Cattle Phenotyping Across Animals and Time
item.description: BoviShift is a six-year visual cattle dataset and evaluation framework that assesses computer vision model performance across changing animal cohorts, breeds, and time.

item.title: [paper] TanCRAFT: Context-Reasoned Anticipatory Feedback for Assembly Tasks
item.description: TanCRAFT is a real-time predictive assistance system that tracks assembly state, forecasts motion, and provides contextual feedback to prevent human errors during physical tasks.

item.title: [paper] C$^2$-Routing: Complementary Cropping and Compression for Efficient Vision-Language Inference
item.description: C2-Routing is an adaptive vision-language inference method that combines image cropping, compression, and a safety gate to reduce computational overhead while preserving accuracy across diverse tasks.

item.title: [paper] Bayesian inverse problems and epidemic-threshold uncertainty for a heterogeneous SIS reaction-diffusion model
item.description: This paper uses Bayesian inference and a uniform second-order expansion to analyze epidemic thresholds and parameter uncertainty in early observations of a heterogeneous SIS reaction-diffusion model.

item.title: [paper] A Theory of Policy Optimization in Post-Training: Coverage Collapse and Reference Resets
item.description: This paper identifies coverage collapse in language model policy optimization and introduces reference resets within Approximate Policy Mirror Descent to guarantee global convergence.

item.title: [paper] One Curve, Different Weights: AUC, the Brier Score, Decision-Weighted AUC, and the Policy Youden Index
item.description: Weighted AUC, or AUC_pi, is proposed as a risk score summary that weighs observation pairs based on a decision maker's probability of acting to consistently evaluate models.

item.title: [paper] A Theory of Cross-Validation Variance
item.description: A finite-sample identity for cross-validation variance is proven, showing that K-fold and leave-pair-out schemes are variance optimal at first order.

item.title: [paper] Accurate predictions of properties of energetic materials with tabular foundation models
item.description: Tabular foundation model TabPFN is shown to outperform tuned machine learning models in predicting impact sensitivity, decomposition temperature, and crystal density of energetic materials.

item.title: [paper] When does text encoding matter for language modeling?
item.description: A hybrid text encoding scheme named Aether is proposed to evaluate how text encoding strategies impact the performance of byte-level language models across diverse languages.

item.title: [paper] A Lightweight Differentiable Method for Real-Time Skin Rendering and Digitization
item.description: A differentiable screen-space subsurface scattering framework is introduced for real-time skin rendering and digitization using lightweight, single-view inputs.

item.title: [paper] Nonparametric Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Mixtures of Logistic Regressions
item.description: A sieve nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator is analyzed for mixtures of logistic regressions to model binary responses with unobserved heterogeneity.

item.title: [paper] UGG: Unified Generative Geometry Model
item.description: Unified Generative Geometry Model jointly models RGB video, depth, and camera pose to improve 4D scene understanding and visual generation.

item.title: [paper] Metric-Aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization for Explainable Deepfake Detection
item.description: Metric-aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization is applied to train a vision-language model pipeline for explainable deepfake detection.

item.title: [paper] One Policy for 100 Household Tasks: Our Solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge
item.description: A single vision-language-action model trained on 211 million frames is demonstrated to handle 100 long-horizon household tasks in the OmniGibson simulator.

item.title: [paper] Two Communities, One Problem: Branch-and-Bound vs. A* for Resource-Constrained Project Scheduling
item.description: A graph-based A* search method is shown to substantially outperform branch-and-bound variants when applied to resource-constrained project scheduling problems.

item.title: [paper] Quantifying the Sampling Frequency Invariance of Time-Series Foundation Models for Sensor Data Applications
item.description: Stress-test study of four prominent time-series foundation models that quantifies their sampling frequency invariance and reveals how performance degradation under lower frequencies reflects information loss.

item.title: [paper] DnNP: Denoising Input Uncertainty in Neural Processes
item.description: Denoising Neural Processes extend the neural process framework using variational inference to explicitly model input uncertainty, significantly improving prediction and uncertainty quantification on noisy datasets.

item.title: [paper] Earlybird: Predictive Streaming Speech Recognition in 29M Parameters
item.description: Earlybird is a 29M-parameter streaming speech recognizer that predicts words accurately before speakers finish them, enabling faster response times for voice agents.

item.title: [paper] OnlyAct: Extracting Action Representations from Foundation Models for World Models
item.description: Label-free contrastive adaptation framework that extracts action representations from pretrained foundation models for video world models without requiring a reconstruction bottleneck.

item.title: [paper] Evaluating LLM-Generated World Models for Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning
item.description: Evaluation of five language models on generating formal world models as partially observable stochastic games, finding that mechanical validity does not guarantee structural agreement for downstream reasoning.

item.title: [paper] Precision on Demand: Escalating Weight Bits at Uncertain Decoding Steps in a Small Local Model
item.description: Method that dynamically escalates weight precision from 4 bits to 8 bits only at uncertain decoding steps in small local language models to optimize memory and accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Exploring Post-Hoc Disentanglement of Audio Foundation Models for Music Similarity
item.description: Study on post-hoc disentanglement of audio foundation models using conditional similarity networks with frozen pretrained embeddings to improve attribute-specific music similarity and retrieval.

item.title: [news] Claude Whiteboards, Claude Sheets, and Claude Data
item.description: Suite of collaborative tools that lets teams brainstorm, build spreadsheets, and share dashboards directly with Claude.

item.title: [paper] Bits or permutations? Spending a fixed inference budget on weight precision or on option-order averaging in small local language models
item.description: Investigation comparing weight precision reductions and option-order averaging for small local language models, providing cost-matched guidelines for spending a fixed inference budget.

item.title: [paper] Causal Concept Explanations for Deep Neural Models
item.description: Causal Concept Wrapper Network uses interventional mediation analysis to align concept-based explanations with neural model outputs, ensuring explanations are necessary, sufficient, and independent.

item.title: [paper] Discovering Equations for the Thermodynamics of South Asian Monsoon Precipitation
item.description: Symbolic distillation approach combining neural networks and symbolic regression to discover interpretable closed-form equations for South Asian monsoon precipitation from reanalysis data.

item.title: [paper] REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding
item.description: REAL Loss is a training loss for speculative decoding that directly optimizes real expected acceptance length using path weights and Rao-Blackwellization, improving language model inference speed without architectural changes.

item.title: [paper] A Margin Perspective on LoRA: Robustness to Catastrophic Forgetting and Adapter Merging (MaLoRA)
item.description: A margin-based perspective on LoRA provides a theoretical explanation for its robustness to catastrophic forgetting and adapter merging by showing optimal adapters align with max-margin solutions.

item.title: [paper] Blurring the Block Boundaries: Overlapping Block Denoising for Efficient Diffusion Language Models
item.description: Blurring the Block Boundaries is a training-free acceleration method for diffusion language models that refines two blocks in parallel within a shared forward pass, improving latency-quality trade-offs.

item.title: [paper] An Energy-Based Perspective on Machine Learning
item.description: This tutorial frames energy-based models as a unifying lens that connects diverse machine learning paradigms through their choice of energy function, inference procedure, and learning method.

item.title: [paper] Cognitive Mapping of Learning by Thinking Mechanisms in Large Language Models
item.description: This paper proposes a Cognitive Learning by Thinking Framework that maps human-like insight acquisition mechanisms onto computational processes in large language models and analyzes their structural failure modes.

item.title: [paper] What Factors Matter for Collection-Level Counting with Human-AI Collaboration?
item.description: This study evaluates human-AI collaboration strategies for collection-level counting across diverse tasks, finding that multimodal models provide strong starting points while fine-tuned detectors excel at larger labeling budgets.

item.title: [paper] Uncertainty-Aware Hybrid Offline Reinforcement Learning with Online Action Selection Enabled by Sparse Gaussian-Process Critics
item.description: A hybrid offline reinforcement learning approach uses a sparse Gaussian-process critic with uncertainty-adjusted action selection to eliminate failed start-ups in industrial control benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] From Video Frames to Robot Meta-Frames: A Unified Latent Interface for World Action Models
item.description: MetaWAM is a unified latent interface for robot world action models that packs all robot signals into a single frequency-domain meta-frame to align with pretrained video diffusion priors without architectural modifications.

item.title: [paper] ARE-bench: Benchmarking Agents' Research Ability in Real-World Researcher Sessions and Workspaces
item.description: ARE-bench is a benchmark of 75 tasks built on real researcher sessions and workspaces to evaluate whether research agents can successfully advance ongoing research projects.

item.title: [paper] The Unused Input: The Initial State as a Conditioning Interface for Recurrent TSFMs
item.description: A novel method utilizes the initial recurrent state in time-series foundation models as a conditioning interface, improving zero-shot forecasting accuracy by injecting context vectors into the hidden state.

item.title: [paper] EngineAgent: Agentizing On-Device LLM Inference Engines with Inference Stack Hierarchy Awareness and Hardware Abilities
item.description: EngineAgent is an agentic system that automates on-device LLM model enablement by separating reusable engine knowledge from model-specific implementation to coordinate cross-layer changes.

item.title: [paper] CLADE: Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
item.description: The study demonstrates that retrieval-augmented language models answer incorrectly when given coarse category-level passages instead of abstaining, a phenomenon termed Clade.

item.title: [paper] AI Isn't Getting Dumber, We're Getting Pickier: Rising Standards in Human Evaluation of Large Language Models
item.description: An analysis of over one million blind votes on Chatbot Arena reveals that human evaluation standards for large language models have steadily risen over time.

item.title: [paper] Forward-Value Discretization: Faster Stochastic Diffusion Sampling Without High-Order Approximation
item.description: Forward-value discretization is a training-free framework that accelerates stochastic diffusion sampling by evaluating the prediction model at a lookahead estimate constructed from previous predictions.

item.title: [paper] When Should Agents Remember? Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
item.description: Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution is a verifier-grounded framework that tests candidate agent lessons as structured hypotheses against targeted probes before committing them to persistent memory.

item.title: [paper] Point-in-Time Encoders for Earnings Calls
item.description: Point-in-time text encoders trained on earnings calls without future data improve information retrieval for financial backtests and question-answering tasks.

item.title: [paper] Auditing the Judge: Internal Signals for LLM Reasoning Assurance
item.description: Supervised correctness probes trained on internal model activations improve error detection and budget allocation compared to using self-judgment verdict scores alone.

item.title: [paper] Don't Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents
item.description: WikiTrace is an evidence-linked memory system that lets AI agents verify and correct past behavioral lessons against their raw execution trajectories to prevent performance degradation.

item.title: [paper] MammothDP: Private Boosted Decision Trees Ready for Trusted Hardware and Leakage-free Hyperparameters
item.description: MammothDP is a differential privacy gradient boosted decision tree system hardened against timing side-channels for secure execution within trusted environments.

item.title: [paper] PSL-RGHA: Parallel Split Learning with Reference Gradient Half-Space Alignment for Mitigating Gradient Divergence
item.description: PSL-RGHA is a parallel split learning framework that uses a reference gradient half-space alignment mechanism to mitigate training divergence across heterogeneous client devices.

item.title: [paper] Multimodal Abstention That Preserves Acquired Correct Answers
item.description: ReFrain is a regression-free abstention method for multimodal models that preserves acquired correct answers while improving correct abstention rates.

item.title: [paper] MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making
item.description: System-1 Decision Models directly make structured probabilistic decisions over query-specified options given a state in a single forward pass, without autoregressively generating reasoning trajectories or textual responses.

item.title: [paper] TaoMate-R1: Temporal Role Specialization for Streaming Multi-Reference Video Generation
item.description: TaoMate-R1 is a streaming multi-reference video generator that uses temporal role specialization to organize adaptation parameters for scene establishment and continuation.

item.title: [paper] ForeseeDrive: Future-Token Conditioning for Anticipatory Generative Driving
item.description: ForeseeDrive is an anticipatory generative driving planner that uses future-token conditioning to shape candidate trajectory generation and improve safety metrics.

item.title: [paper] LM-SimBench: A Unified Framework, Dataset, and Benchmark for Large Language Model Training Simulation
item.description: LM-SimBench is a unified framework, dataset, and benchmark for evaluating and comparing large language model training simulators across parallelization configurations.

item.title: [paper] Ninety-Six Ways to Measure a Scribe: Fragmented Evaluation of Ambient Scribes in Healthcare
item.description: This paper reviews evaluation studies of ambient AI scribes in healthcare to highlight metric fragmentation and the need for standardized assessment protocols.

item.title: [paper] UniFlow-RS: Unified Generative Prediction for Heterogeneous Remote-Sensing Tasks
item.description: UniFlow-RS is a remote-sensing foundation model that uses a shared latent flow-matching predictor to handle heterogeneous tasks and datasets.

item.title: [paper] AutoThreshold: Joint Confusion-Profile Learning for Adaptive Mask Binarization
item.description: AutoThreshold is a post-hoc policy that predicts joint confusion profiles to enable adaptive mask binarization for any target objective without retraining.

item.title: [paper] Compositional random forest
item.description: This paper presents a random forest framework for compositional responses using log-likelihood gain as a split criterion across simplex, log-ratio, and directional spaces.

item.title: [paper] Federated Learning for Cross-Regional Epidemic Forecasting with Asynchronous Outbreaks
item.description: This paper evaluates a federated learning framework for cross-regional epidemic forecasting using asynchronous COVID-19 data while preserving data privacy.

item.title: [paper] Achieving Robust Channel Estimation Neural Networks on Doppler effects by Designed Training Data
item.description: This paper proposes design criteria for generating synthetic training data that enable offline-trained neural networks to perform robust channel estimation across high Doppler shifts.

item.title: [paper] Physics-Constrained Autoencoder for Interpretable Health Representation Learning in Turbofan Engines
item.description: Physics-constrained autoencoder that embeds system knowledge into the decoder and loss function to learn interpretable health representations and track degradation in turbofan engines.

item.title: [paper] Chain of Physics: Supporting Fault Diagnosis with Engineering-Inspired Large Language Model Reasoning
item.description: Chain of Physics is an LLM-based fault-diagnosis framework that uses a constrained knowledge graph generated from reference documentation to retrieve and reason about failure modes and sensor data.

item.title: [paper] Recurrent Modular Structure in Spiking Neural Network Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Community Recurrent Spiking Neural Networks partition recurrent networks into communities with fixed roles to improve reinforcement learning performance and generate compressible spike activity.

item.title: [paper] Lilo: A Multi-Agent Conversational Sandbox for Children's Digital Communication
item.description: Lilo is a multi-agent conversational system that allows children to practice navigating peer conflicts and communicate more effectively through simulated group chat arguments and mentor interventions.

item.title: [paper] Elastic-WAM: Adaptive Spatiotemporal Imagination for Efficient Robot Control
item.description: Elastic-WAM is a robot control framework that adaptively allocates world refinement computation across temporal and spatial regions to improve task success while reducing inference latency.

item.title: [paper] A Cross-Scenario Survey and Analysis of Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents
item.description: Cross-scenario survey and analysis framework that evaluates the portability of self-evolving multimodal agent mechanisms by categorizing scarce factors and task-structural resources.

item.title: [paper] Location Matters: Sparse Latent-Variance Attacks for Face Privacy against Diffusion Personalization
item.description: Sparse Encoder Attack on Latent Variance is a sparse adversarial protection framework that modifies a small fraction of facial image locations to disrupt identity acquisition in diffusion models.

item.title: [paper] Semantic Chains: From Reachable Facts to Justified Answers
item.description: Semantic Chains is a logical modeling framework that constructs connected sequences of facts from a question to find and justify correct answers.

item.title: [paper] Personalized Affective Perception via Continual Learning in Human-Agent Negotiation
item.description: Affect-adaptive negotiation strategy that uses continual learning for facial expression recognition to personalize valence-arousal perception in real-time human-agent interactions.

item.title: [paper] SinkState: On-the-Fly SVD of Recurrent States for Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving
item.description: SinkState is an efficient hybrid LLM serving system that stores recurrent states in an adaptive low-rank form using on-the-fly SVD to reduce memory traffic and speed up decoding.

item.title: [paper] An AI Assistant for Automating Anti-Corruption Expertise of Draft Legislation Based on the TRACE Framework
item.description: An AI assistant uses a deterministic parsing core and language models to screen draft legislation for corruption risks and regulatory defects.

item.title: [paper] Dyship: Leveraging Acoustic Features For Speaker Relationship Classification From Dyadic Conversations
item.description: Dyship is a framework for classifying speaker familiarity and kinship from dyadic conversations using conventional acoustic features.

item.title: [paper] On Federated Averaging with Partial Participation under a General Variance Condition
item.description: Federated Averaging with partial participation is analyzed under a general variance condition, establishing a finite-time stationarity bound without requiring bounded gradient dissimilarity.

item.title: [paper] StaRSE: Compact Russian Sentence Embeddings with a Sign-Coded Static Encoder
item.description: StaRSE is a compact Russian static sentence encoder that eliminates Transformer inference at deployment time by storing token directions as sign bits and norms separately.

item.title: [paper] Stagewise and interpretable emergence of inside-outside computation in Transformer-based language models
item.description: A synthetic context-free grammar study reveals that Transformers develop inside-outside parsing in interpretable, stagewise learning curves that transition from local to abstract representations.

item.title: [paper] SHARP: Semantic Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for Next POI Prediction with Dynamic Memory
item.description: SHARP is an agentic hierarchical framework that combines category-level reasoning, dynamic trajectory memory, and time-aware transition graphs to predict next points of interest.

item.title: [paper] ViGA-FLAME: Aligning Latent Visual and Geometric Representations for Robust 3D Head Expression Estimation
item.description: ViGA-FLAME is a two-stage framework that aligns semantic visual features with a structured geometric latent space to enable robust 3D head expression estimation.

item.title: [paper] Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class: A Policed Quality-of-Service Mechanism for Agentic AI Traffic, Evaluated from Simulation to Real-Kernel Adversarial Testing
item.description: Verifiable Agentic Traffic Class is a policed quality-of-service mechanism that uses reserved DSCP values, router-side classification, and rate-limiting to manage software agent network traffic.

item.title: [paper] Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
item.description: Tree-Ising repairs reasoning loops in LLM weights by solving sparse Ising/QUBO problems over BF16 parameters, improving math benchmark accuracy with fewer weight edits and no gradient or LLM-token cost.

item.title: [paper] Breakdown of Autoregressive Multi-Step Reasoning Under Concentrated vs. Diffuse Attention Head Dropout
item.description: Concentrated bursts of attention head masking cause significantly worse reasoning degradation in autoregressive language models compared to diffuse, budget-matched dropout.

item.title: [paper] DailyWildfireCAN: A Dataset and Benchmark for Next-Day Wildfire Spread Prediction in Canada
item.description: DailyWildfireCAN is a multi-modal dataset and benchmark tracking continuous fire progression across Canada to support next-day wildfire spread prediction.

item.title: [paper] Joint Quantization and Dynamic Partitioning for Context-Aware Edge Vision Transformers
item.description: Edge orchestration framework that jointly optimizes model partition points, quantization bitwidths, and execution placement to reduce communication energy and latency in vehicular vision transformer systems.

item.title: [paper] An Augmented Lagrangian Approach to Lifted Bellman Linear Programming
item.description: Temporal-difference critic solver using the method of multipliers to solve lifted bellman linear programming without a target network, achieving high success rates on offline reinforcement learning tasks.

item.title: [paper] SpecValley: Aggregation as Spectral Valley in Dense Heterophilic Graphs
item.description: Node classification framework that learns aggregation position, sharpness, and flank gains prior to spectral filtering, improving performance on dense heterophilic graphs.

item.title: [tool] Aircad – Professional drafting and 3D modeling in the browser
item.description: Browser-based professional CAD system featuring NURBS solid modeling, multiplayer editing, and deep AI integration.

item.title: [paper] Cross-Border Fulfillment Center Selection via Doubly Robust Estimation and Linear Programming
item.description: Cross-border fulfillment center selection framework combining forecasting, doubly robust estimation, and linear programming to minimize delivery time and shipping costs while maximizing profit.

item.title: [paper] BARS: Budget-Aware Sequential Sampling with Refusal for Majority Identification under Unknown Distributions
item.description: Sequential sampling rule with budgeting and refusal mechanisms that certifies error rates and improves accuracy for majority identification in large language models.

item.title: [paper] Representational Atoms in Neural Networks
item.description: Threshold-activated sparse autoencoders framework that identifies fundamental representational units with high fidelity and stability to analyze neural network internal representations and human conceptual structure.

item.title: [paper] Nonadaptive One-Sided Testing of Binary Rank
item.description: Nonadaptive entry-query tester for binary matrices that uses a specified number of queries independent of dimensions to test binary rank with one-sided error.

item.title: [paper] Unipolar Neuron Networks Trained by Recirculation for Reward-Based Continual Learning
item.description: Unipolar neuron network model utilizing a recirculation learning rule and task-specific inhibition mechanisms to achieve reward-based continual learning with low catastrophic forgetting.

item.title: [paper] From Search to Decision: How Post-Training Shapes Information-Seeking Capabilities in Large Language Models
item.description: Survey paper that organizes research around six information-seeking capabilities in large language models, examining learning signals, optimization methods, and evaluation practices.

item.title: [paper] GARD: Gradient-Guided Adversarial Representation Defense against Backdoors in Multimodal Contrastive Learning Models
item.description: Gradient-guided adversarial representation defense framework that uses global and local adversarial probes to eliminate backdoor vulnerabilities in multimodal contrastive learning models without extra inference cost.

item.title: [paper] Deviation-Aware Pretraining for Cardiovascular Disease Detection from Electrocardiograms
item.description: Self-supervised framework that analyzes electrocardiogram signals using deviation localization and association reconstruction to improve cardiovascular disease detection without requiring labeled data.

item.title: [paper] HaiRuo: Forecasting Ocean Eddies as Fields and Objects with a Satellite-Altimetry Foundation Model
item.description: Open-weight foundation model paired with an object decoder that forecasts ocean eddies as both spatial fields and moving objects from satellite altimetry data.

item.title: [paper] Sim(3)-TurboReg: Robust and Efficient Scale-Aware Registration via Tri-Scale Consistency
item.description: Sim(3) registration solver that uses a tri-scale consistency criterion to eliminate mismatching outliers and enable efficient, kilometer-scale 3D reconstruction for streaming systems.

item.title: [paper] Right for the Wrong Reasons? Evaluating Plausibility and Behavioral Change in Explanation-Guided Learning
item.description: Benchmark framework that evaluates how different explanation-guided learning objectives affect model plausibility, behavioral change, and robustness against synthetic shortcuts.

item.title: [paper] Continuous 3D Spatial Transcriptomics Reconstruction via Histology-Informed Implicit Neural Representations
item.description: Implicit neural representation model that reconstructs continuous 3D gene-expression patterns from sparse spatial transcriptomics data by leveraging auxiliary histological images.

item.title: [paper] Hierarchical Graph Representation Learning with Pooling-Induced Substructures
item.description: Graph neural network approach that explicitly preserves pooling-induced substructures to improve hierarchical graph representation learning and reasoning.

item.title: [paper] CroCoMAE: Cross-modal self-supervised collaborative representation learning for SAR-optical remote sensing data
item.description: Cross-modal self-supervised learning framework that combines contrastive learning and masked image modeling at image and patch levels to improve SAR-optical remote sensing analysis.

item.title: [paper] Hx2Dx: From Anamnesis to Diagnosis - A Multimodal Arena for Conversational Clinical Reasoning in LLMs
item.description: Interactive benchmark based on clinical cases from the New England Journal of Medicine that evaluates how large language models perform iterative, conversational clinical reasoning and diagnosis.

item.title: [paper] TAMEing the Open-World Personalization: Towards Open-Set Personalized MLLM Assistant
item.description: Long-context open-set personalized multimodal large language model assistant that uses a training-free concept reconciliation skill to automatically incorporate novel user-specific concepts during interactions.

item.title: [paper] Visual Similarity in Adult Word Extension and Artificial Word Learning
item.description: Study using a self-supervised visual encoder to analyze how visual similarity and example composition influence adult word extension and artificial word learning.

item.title: [paper] Looking One Step Ahead: An Anticipation-guided Agent for Object State Readout in Videos
item.description: Look-ahead state readout is an anticipation-guided agent for video object state readout that uses expected next-step changes to inspect current frames and refine state records.

item.title: [paper] Model-Free Runtime Measurement of Task-Relevant Information
item.description: Acquisition-State Telemetry is a model-free architecture for autonomous systems that emits real-time signals to quantify prospective task progress and informational friction from ongoing observations.

item.title: [paper] ProofCoder: Continuous Reasoning for Automated Software Verification
item.description: ProofCoder is an agentic proof-synthesis system for Rocq that uses continuous reasoning and proof-assistant feedback to iteratively construct, repair, and refine software verification proofs.

item.title: [paper] Sckwoky at SHROOM-Visions: Character-Level Hallucination-Span Detection in Image-Conditioned VLMs via Dual-Prompted LoRA Decoders
item.description: Sven and colleagues present a character-level hallucination span detection system for image-conditioned vision-language models that uses a Gemma backbone, LoRA adapters, and a repeated-answer prompt strategy.

item.title: [paper] Opportunity-Cost Option-Critic: Adaptive Switching Costs for Robust Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Opportunity-Cost Option-Critic is a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that uses state-dependent deliberation costs based on value gaps to improve option persistence and adaptation in non-stationary environments.

item.title: [paper] CUVE: Making Supervised Classification more Accessible through Visualization
item.description: CUVE is an interface that allows users to build supervised classifiers by generating human- and algorithm-interpretable visualizations as an intermediate representation.

item.title: [paper] BODYinTRANSIT-Lab: A Multimodal Dataset for Investigating Sensory-Driven Transformations in Body Perception and Affective Experiences
item.description: BODYinTRANSIT-Lab is a multimodal dataset capturing synchronised behavioural, physiological, affective, and body perception responses to manipulated walking feedback, accompanied by a deep learning classification benchmark.

item.title: [paper] Sable: A Small-Field Sumcheck Argument for Bit-Exact Inference of Large Language Models
item.description: Sable is an argument system and single-GPU prover that generates bit-exact, integer-quantized transformer inference proofs for large language models using Reed-Solomon codes and multilinear commitments.

item.title: [paper] From Bias to Positionality: A critical grammar for Large Language Models
item.description: This paper proposes positionality as an analytical grammar for large language models to describe the located, multi-layered perspective from which a model speaks across its corpus, tuning, and prompts.

item.title: [paper] ZoomGain: Mining Global-to-Zoom Perception Gaps for Fine-Grained Visual Supervision
item.description: ZoomGain is a data construction pipeline that exploits global-to-zoom perception gaps in vision-language models to automatically generate fine-grained visual supervision questions and benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Obscured Wildfire Flame Detection by Spatio-temporal Analysis of Smoke Patterns Using Frame-wise Transformers
item.description: Deep learning model that uses a frame-wise transformer architecture on RGB video to detect visible and obscured wildfire flames for aerial drone monitoring.

item.title: [paper] What a CAGE 4 Score Measures: An Audit of a Learned Cyber-Defense Benchmark, Its Reference Defenders, and the Tables Built on Them
item.description: Study of the CAGE Challenge 4 cyber-defense benchmark that identifies how simulator behaviors and evaluation setups distort the performance measurements of learned multi-agent defenders.

item.title: [paper] Generalizing Causal Decision-Making: Markov Equivalence, Transportability and Counterfactuals
item.description: Framework of structural causal bandits that uses partial causal structures, environment information, and counterfactual actions to guide exploration and improve decision-making.

item.title: [paper] Where Do Vision-Language Models Get Left and Right? Position-Code Counterfactuals in Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL and InternVL3
item.description: Analysis of vision-language models demonstrating that vision transformer position codes are both necessary and largely sufficient for determining left-right spatial orientation.

item.title: [paper] HandsOnAid: Building and Evaluating an Offline First-Aid Assistant for Emergency Response Scenarios
item.description: HandsOnAid is an offline first-aid assistant built on a fine-tuned 4-bit Gemma 2B model that provides safe and accurate emergency medical guidance without internet connectivity.

item.title: [paper] CURRENT: A Recurrent Neural Network for Concurrent Spatial and Temporal Super-Resolution of 4D Flow MRI
item.description: CURRENT is a recurrent neural network that performs simultaneous spatial and temporal super-resolution on 4D flow MRI velocity vector fields to improve aortic blood flow analysis.

item.title: [paper] Can KV Cache Be Reused Across Model Updates? A DeepSeek-V4-Flash Case Study
item.description: Study on cross-version key-value cache reuse in language models showing that caches can retain task utility and speed up inference despite underlying weight updates.

item.title: [paper] Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction and Robust Evidence Retrieval for Indian Knowledge Systems
item.description: Ontology-guided knowledge graph pipeline that links extracted entities and relations to original text to improve evidence retrieval for Indian Knowledge Systems.

item.title: [paper] Structured Confidence Perturbation via Fisher Geometry for Adversarial Training
item.description: Adversarial training method that uses a hybrid objective and Fisher geometry perturbations to disrupt model confidence structures and improve adversarial robustness.

item.title: [paper] Thermodynamics of words
item.description: Theoretical framework modeling word frequency distributions in literary works as a thermalization process analogous to Rayleigh-Jeans condensation in physical systems.

item.title: [paper] From Show Programs to Linked Data
item.description: Workflow combining vision-language models and knowledge graphs that transforms heritage show programs into structured data for performing arts historiography.

item.title: [paper] MISO-BR: An Open Corpus for Misogyny Detection in Brazilian Portuguese
item.description: MISO-BR is an open, annotated corpus of social media texts designed for detecting misogyny in Brazilian Portuguese.

item.title: [paper] ScaleBrain: A Scale-Consistent Framework for EEG Foundation Models
item.description: ScaleBrain is a scale-consistent pre-training framework for EEG foundation models that coordinates multi-scale representations across model inputs and optimization objectives.
